title: Make a work card carry its deliverable before it reaches the CEO
tier_reason: This card let an agent's stray sentence stand in for the result he was promised.
ask:
Accepted “Redraw the boot bloom so the player rises from behind the petals, with before-and-after animations to review”. This card let an agent's stray sentence stand in for the result he was promised.

Daniel authorized the 2026-09-21 redesign. Implement HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md section2 after section1: extend the shared backend readiness projection. Keep unprepared work out of the default ready queue but discoverable with missing evidence named; preserve informed explicit verdicts on finished results. Do not use a frontend-only gate or fabricate recommendations.
first_action: Read docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md sections1–3 and the reviewed implementation contract; extend the shared backend readiness projection with inspectable deliverable and preparation requirements.
source_message: Accepted “Redraw the boot bloom so the player rises from behind the petals, with before-and-after animations to review”.
result:
The shared readiness projection now requires a named deliverable, inspectable evidence, a clear question, an honest recommendation or documented reason none fits, and recorded consequences before a work card enters Daniel’s default queue.

Incomplete cards remain visible with machine-readable missing requirements. Finished results can still request an explicit verdict without a fabricated recommendation. Terra’s original implementation was corrected against both preserved Sol findings without a second model review: consequences now require concrete follow-up work or the canonical empty list for no work, and focused fixtures cover every missing briefing field plus malformed consequences. All nine HQ scripts passed, followed by 2,853 unit checks and 968 integration checks with zero failures. Committed as 0c5951e after explicit operator verification.

model_selection.policy: Cost-conscious redesign: Terra build, Sol review once, escalate only when needed.
